visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young women are positioned in a brightly lit, minimalist indoor studio with a large window in the background. They are wearing matching yellow Pikachu ear headbands. The woman on the left is dressed in a white tank top under a grey oversized cardigan and grey shorts; the woman in the center wears a deep red, low-cut long-sleeved top and a black skirt; the woman on the right wears a black cropped top and a pleated grey skirt. They are all leaning forward deeply with their hands resting on their knees, looking directly into the camera. (2) The women begin to gradually shift their posture, moving from a deep forward lean to a slightly more upright position. Their hands remain on their thighs as they slowly extend their backs. Above their heads, numerical text overlays appear and change as they move, reflecting their changing heights relative to their posture. (3) The trio continues to stand up straighter in a synchronized motion. The center woman and the left woman are now in a semi-upright stance, while the woman on the right maintains a more stable height. The numbers above their heads are updated once again to indicate their progress. (4) All three women are now standing fully upright and tall. They look at the camera with confident, neutral expressions. The final height values are displayed as static text overlays above each of their heads, showing the disparity in their actual heights. The camera remains static throughout the sequence.

No incidental noises or speech are detected, maintaining a high signal-to-noise ratio focused entirely on the studio-produced BGM. (3) The melodic loop repeats with consistent intensity. The harmonic structure remains simple and looping, with the synth pads and drums maintaining a uniform volume. There is no evidence of audio compression artifacts or distortion, indicating a clean master track. (4) The track concludes abruptly with a hard cut at the end of the video segment. The energy level remains high until the final frame, with the female vocals and rhythmic beat stopping simultaneously.
